recordSchema.profileId: required for V1 engine-artifact records; default-v1
recordSchema.profileStateAtTest: required for V1 engine-artifact records; ready
recordSchema.profileFingerprint: required for V1 engine-artifact records; target-specific sha256:<64 hex>
recordSchema.privacyDescriptor: required for V1 engine-artifact records; explicit transfer booleans
recordSchema.externalProviderNames: required for V1 engine-artifact records and identical across targets
recordSchema.orchestrationSessionSha256: required for browser records; native-smoke checkpoint for unpacked, evidence-promoted checkpoint for Store-installed
recordSchema.storeSubmissionHandoffSha256: required for store-installed-extension; exact pre-Store handoff identity
recordSchema.storeCandidateSha256: required for store-installed-extension; exact submitted candidate SHA-256
recordSchema.storeItemId: required for store-installed-extension; Chrome Web Store item id
recordSchema.storeVersion: required for store-installed-extension; installed Store version
